subject: Connector vendor privacy clearance and evidence escalation
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@clearsync.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Connector vendor: DPA scope & escrow question

Hi Olga / Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. Procurement at BigBank asked us to confirm a few privacy and transfer details before we proceed to the legal review:

- Can you share the current subprocessor roster used by the connector (including region/country for each vendor)?
- Where are your KMS keys and any backup/escrow arrangements hosted (jurisdiction)?
- Do any telemetry/observability partners retain identifiable logs outside of the EU/US (we need specifics for our DPA)?

I attached our RFP extract that highlights the items we need. A clear mapping or short export of subprocessors + data flow would help our legal team.

Also copying procurement@bigbank.com for awareness.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — their review window is tight.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Head of Integrations, ClearSync
[attachment: clearsync-rfp.pdf (pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@clearsync.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, procurement@bigbank.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jul 2025 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Connector vendor: DPA scope & escrow question

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. I've attached our current subprocessor roster export and a quick diagram showing the primary egress regions. High level answers below and we'll follow up with more detailed evidence:

- Subprocessors: attached CSV contains vendor name, role, country. We're using a mix of EU and US-based partners; a few analytics partners route via a CDN in Singapore for edge caching.
- KMS/HSM: Ben (copied) is confirming the exact KMS cluster locations and whether escrow/backups are in a separate jurisdiction.
- Telemetry: We have two observability partners; logs that contain tenant identifiers are retained in the EU by default, but there is a temporary pipeline for real-time metrics that may traverse APAC for edge aggregation — see the diagram.

Next steps:
1) Ben to confirm KMS provider/jurisdiction and attach SOC2/KMS attestation.
2) Laura (cc'd) to pull an evidence bundle for EU transfers (artifacts, export map).
3) Schedule a 30m sync with ClearSync legal & BigBank procurement — propose Thu 7/3 08:00-09:00 PT.

Attaching: clearsync-subprocessor-list.csv, subprocessor-export-map.png

Best,
Olga Petrov
Privacy & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: clearsync-subprocessor-list.csv (csv)]
[attachment: subprocessor-export-map.png (png)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Connector vendor: DPA scope & escrow question

Forwarding Elena's note — security_compliance flag.

Jonas / Laura — please review the attached CSV and export map. Laura, can you prioritize: (a) EU transfer matrix + names of subprocessors that touch EEA personal data; (b) any hosted key jurisdictions and whether we have key escrow arrangements; (c) SOC2/KMS attestation artifacts we can share under NDA?

Jonas — does the edge cache callout (Singapore) sound right from the routing map? If so, we should list the temporary APAC aggregator as a transient processor and provide mitigation notes (TTL, no PII persisted).

I'll line up the call with ClearSync + BigBank once we have Ben/Laura confirmations.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Olga / team — quick confirmations below and attaching the KMS attestation.

- KMS/HSM: We use KeyHarbor as our KMS provider. Primary cluster for customer keys is hosted in Ireland (eu-west-1). We maintain an offsite backup key escrow in a separate KeyHarbor cluster also in Ireland; no keys are escrowed in APAC.
- SOC2 / Attestations: KeyHarbor provided a scoped SOC2 report for their EU cluster — attached (redacted).
- Telemetry: The edge aggregator in Singapore performs metric aggregation only; it does not persist personally identifiable content. Any tenant identifiers are hashed and TTL'd to 30 minutes.

Attaching: keyharbor-soc2.pdf

If you need a signed attestation, I can engage KeyHarbor to produce a customer-specific letter (2-3 business days).

Ben Carter
Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
[attachment: keyharbor-soc2.pdf (pdf)]
